description: Use when a user asks "A or B?", "what's the difference between these" or "which fits my room better". Put 2 or 3 products (ids from search_home_gym_gear, e.g. sg-001) side by side: specs table (including the guide's pros and cons), fit notes (ceiling, floor space, capacity, price) and a plain summary of the differences, built only from the guide data. Each product keeps its guide_url and buy_url; show buy_url to users exactly as given.
